Our Services

Comprehensive orthotic, prosthetic and medical compression care tailored to your needs

01

Custom Orthotics

Individually designed orthotic devices crafted to support your unique biomechanical needs and rehabilitation goals.

  • Custom-fit upper and lower limb orthoses
  • Spinal and neurological support devices
  • Paediatric orthotic solutions
  • Precision-crafted insoles and supports
02

Off-the-Shelf Orthotics

High-quality prefabricated orthotic devices for immediate support during recovery, injury management, or post-operative care.

  • Joint braces and post-operative supports
  • Injury management and soft support
  • Sports bracing and protection
  • Ready-to-use mobility solutions
03

Mobility Aids

Professional mobility equipment to support safe movement and independence in daily living and rehabilitation.

  • Crutches, walking sticks, and frames
  • Wheelchairs and transfer aids
  • Toilet seat raisers and bathroom support
  • Expert guidance on proper use
04

Medical Compression

Our compression specialism: graduated compression stockings, pantyhose and made-to-measure compression garments in compression class A to class 3.

  • Below-knee (BK) and thigh-high (AK) compression stockings
  • Compression pantyhose, tights and maternity compression
  • Compression class A, 1, 2 and 3: measured and fitted
  • Flat-knit compression for lymphoedema and lipoedema
05

Breast & Silicone Prosthetics

Compassionate, dignified care for breast, facial, and digit prosthetic needs with a focus on comfort and natural appearance.

  • Breast prostheses and nipple solutions
  • Finger and toe prosthetics
  • Facial and cosmetic prostheses
  • Private, respectful fittings
06

Upper & Lower Limb Prosthetics

Advanced prosthetic solutions designed to restore function, mobility, and confidence for individuals with limb loss.

  • Upper and lower limb prostheses
  • Paediatric prosthetic care
  • Functional and cosmetic designs
  • Ongoing support and adjustments

Our compression specialism

We specialise in medical compression

A dedicated lower-limb compression clinic within the practice: graduated compression stockings, compression pantyhose and made-to-measure compression garments, in compression class A through class 3, measured and fitted on the leg.

Personalised Care, Wherever You Need It

I am an HPCSA-registered Orthotist & Prosthetist currently practising in Morningside, Sandton, where I provide comprehensive orthotic, prosthetic and medical compression services.

My clinical approach begins with a thorough assessment of each patient’s needs, lifestyle and goals. I believe that orthotic and prosthetic care should never be about simply selecting a device from available stock. It should be about finding the right solution for the individual.

My areas of clinical interest include custom orthotics, prosthetic rehabilitation, medical compression, breast prostheses and post-operative support, with a particular focus on providing solutions that are practical, comfortable and clinically appropriate.

Where appropriate, I also provide consultations at hospitals, healthcare facilities and patients’ homes, particularly when mobility, recovery or medical circumstances make travelling difficult.

I work closely with patients and their healthcare teams, so that every device fits the wider plan for recovery and for daily life.
